visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Assigning Without nonlocal
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Calling the counter should print 1 and then 2, but the program crashes with an UnboundLocalError.
visualizerParams.buggyCode:
def make_counter():
    count = 0

    def increment():

        count += 1
        return count

    return increment


counter = make_counter()
print(counter())
print(counter())

solution.code:
def make_counter():
    count = 0

    def increment():
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        return count

    return increment


counter = make_counter()
print(counter())
print(counter())
solution.explanation: count += 1 assigns to count, so Python treats count as a local variable of increment, which has no value yet. nonlocal count says it is the variable of the enclosing function.
